changes.to: Maker pages checked 2026-11-25: pib.Pro is described as Europe's first open, ready-to-ship humanoid platform, GDPR-compliant and modular, with stronger hardware and higher payload than pib, advanced 3D vision, LiDAR, onboard AI, and ROS software modules developed by its community; it is offered to pilot customers rather than sold as a catalogue product. The maker publishes no numeric specifications (height, weight, payload, speed, runtime, degrees of freedom, battery) for pib.Pro, so every value is left empty — figures circulating on aggregator sites are not maker values and are not used. pib, the 3D-printable predecessor, is a separate maker project.

pib.Pro is isento's ready-to-ship open-source humanoid platform, the professional step up from the 3D-printable pib: stronger actuators and payload, 3D vision and LiDAR, onboard AI and a modular ROS-based stack, sold through a pilot-partner programme.
